passport.title: Product passport
passport.lead: Describe your product. For each pilot city we compute Fit: how far the product answers the purchase levers consumers cite. It applies to your organisation only.

list.label: Your organisation's passports
list.emptyBody: Without a passport there is no Fit and it does not enter MOS. A name, a category and the claims you can support are enough.
list.emptyViewer: Your organisation has no passport yet. Your role can read them, not create them.
list.viewer: Your role can read passports, not create or edit them.
list.claims: {count, plural, =0 {no claims} one {# claim} other {# claims}}

form.leadNew: After saving you see Fit city by city.
form.name: Product name
form.categoryHint: Fit is computed on the pilot cities of this category.
form.otherCertificationsHint: Up to 5, separated by commas, 20 characters each at most.
form.claimsLead: Tick only what you can prove. Each item is a purchase lever: Fit measures how many of the levers cited in a territory the product covers.
form.impliedNote: DOP, IGP and STG already count as Certifications and Origin; BIO as Certifications and Organic; the Entry band as Value for money.
form.deleteConfirm: Delete this passport? Fit disappears from your organisation's Opportunities.
form.saved: Passport saved. The Fit below uses the updated data.

error.name: Give the product a name, 120 characters at most.
error.category: Choose a category from the list.
error.priceBand: This price band is not valid.
error.certifications: Check the other certifications: 5 at most, each within 20 characters.
error.claims: One of the claims is not valid.
error.format: The format can be 120 characters at most.
error.capacity: The capacity can be 120 characters at most.
error.story: The story can be 2000 characters at most.
error.failed: We could not save. Try again shortly.

claims.origin_territory: The product is tied to a place you can name and document.
claims.quality_taste: Quality and taste are the main reason to choose it.
claims.artisanal_tradition: Made by craft methods or to a traditional recipe.
claims.certification: It carries a recognised mark or certification.
claims.organic_natural: Organic, or made with natural ingredients and no additives.
claims.health_nutrition: It has a nutrition or health profile you can state.
claims.price_value: It costs less than alternatives of the same quality.
claims.convenience: It is practical: ready to use, portioned or easy to store.
claims.sustainability: Low-impact supply chain, packaging or production.
claims.brand_trust: The brand is known and considered reliable.
claims.novelty: It is new: a taste, format or idea not yet widespread.

detail.readOnly: Your role can read this passport, not edit it.
detail.notFoundBody: It does not exist or belongs to another organisation.

fit.title: Fit by city
fit.lead: Share of purchase-lever citations the product answers, in the latest published consumer reading for {category} in the city's country. It comes from online posts, not a representative sample: grade C.
fit.answersNone: The passport does not answer any lever yet. Tick the claims you can support: until you do, Fit stays at zero wherever there is a reading.
fit.impliedLegend: Levers marked "{label}" come from the certifications or the price band, not from a claim.
fit.noReadingLong: Without a published reading there is no Fit: it is not zero and it does not enter MOS.
fit.noneTitle: No published reading for this category
fit.noneBody: Fit is computed on the levers of a published consumer reading. For {category} there is none yet in any country of the pilot cities: no Fit, not zero.
fit.method: Method {method}. The percentile compares this passport's cities with each other and is the value that enters MOS.

opportunities.note: Scores specific to your organisation: for {category} they include the Fit of the passport "{name}" and are recomputed here in the browser. Other categories stay as stored; only their position in the ranking changes. System scores do not change.
opportunities.noFit: Passport "{name}": there is no published consumer reading for its category, so no Fit. You see the system scores, unchanged.
opportunities.noCells: Passport "{name}": no cell of its category is in this list, so Fit changes nothing here. You see the system scores, unchanged.
opportunities.notFound: This passport does not exist or does not belong to your organisation. You see the system scores.
opportunities.weightsFitNote: Fit comes from the passport "{name}" and applies to {category} only. For other cells its weight lowers coverage.
